text: For the Keansburg site, the chance of a major flood over [[30 years|assumed]] is about [[26%|modeled]] on current maps and about [[35%|modeled]] with sea level rise, with a range of [[32%|modeled]] to [[38%|modeled]]. Raising the lowest floor [[2 ft|assumed]] above the base flood elevation reduces those [[30-year|assumed]] odds to about [[8%|modeled]]. The ground at the site sits about [[5.2 ft|measured]] below the base flood elevation, which has a measured height of [[11 ft|measured]].
